integrity: Complete exact derivations and a standalone Python 3 finite verifier are included.
scientific_limitations: The classical marginal inversion-generating polynomials and their moment consequences are prior work. The claimed contribution concerns the individual-pair gap profile and a uniform all-class strictly monotone coupling. Theorems cover uniform involution conjugacy classes, not arbitrary permutations conditioned on fixed points. Finite checks are not unlimited proofs; independent priority assessment has not been performed.
title: Spatial inversion law and monotone matching coupling for uniform involutions
